avatarDescription: Click the avatar to upload an image, or use the buttons below.
avatarSupportHint: Supports JPG and PNG, up to 5MB
usernameHint: Your username identifies you in the system.
languageHint: Currently only affects stored preference; UI language switching will be improved in future versions.
timezoneHint: Choose the timezone that matches your location to improve time display accuracy.
toastEmailNotChanged: New email is same as current email
toastVerificationCodeRequired: 6-digit verification code is required when changing email
toastCodeSent: Verification code sent to new email
toastCodeSendFailed: Failed to send verification code, please try again
verificationCodeHint: Please check your new email inbox for the verification code (valid for 5 minutes)
sshKeyConfirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete key "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
securityPasswordDescription: Regularly update your password to keep your account secure.
securityPasswordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
securityPasswordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
securityPasswordChanged: Password updated successfully. Please sign in again.
securityPasswordOldIncorrect: Current password is incorrect. Please try again.
securityPasswordLengthInsufficient: New password is too short, it must be at least 6 characters.
securityGoogleDescription: Link Google so you can sign in to this account with Google.
securityGoogleDisabledHint: Google sign-in is not enabled. Ask an administrator to configure it in system settings.
securityGoogleUnlinkConfirmDescription: After unlinking, you will no longer be able to sign in to this account with that Google account. Make sure you can still sign in with a password or another method.
security2faDescription: Enhance account security using a TOTP authenticator app.
security2faStatusEnabled: Enabled, using an authenticator app to verify sign-in.
security2faStatusDisabled: Disabled. It is recommended to enable 2FA for better security.
security2faRecommendApps: We recommend Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or any other TOTP-compatible app.
security2faScanQrToast: Please scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
security2faEnableFailed: Failed to enable 2FA. Please check the verification code.
security2faDisableFailed: Failed to disable 2FA. Please check the verification code.
securitySessionsRevokeAllOthersSuccess: All other sessions have been revoked.
security2faQrDialogDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator).
security2faCodeInputHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
security2faBackupDialogDescription: These backup codes can be used to sign in when you cannot access your authenticator app. Each code can only be used once. Please store them safely.
security2faBackupCopyHint: We recommend storing these codes in your password manager or printing them and keeping them in a safe place.
security2faDisableDialogDescription: Disabling 2FA will reduce your account security. Enter the verification code from your authenticator app to confirm this action.
notificationsTaskDescription: Choose which background task results create and send notifications.
notificationsTaskInAppDescription: Keep task results in the notification center.
notificationsTaskSuccessDescription: Notify when a task completes successfully.
notificationsTaskFailureDescription: Notify when a task fails or times out.
notificationsTaskPartialDescription: Notify when a batch task contains failed items.
notificationsTaskExternalDescription: Also send through enabled email, webhook, DingTalk, or WeCom channels.
notificationsSecurityDescription: Get notified when unusual login activity is detected to protect your account.
notificationsNewDeviceDescription: Send an alert when your account is accessed from a new device.
notificationsNewLocationDescription: Send an alert when your account is accessed from a new geographic location.
notificationsSuspiciousDescription: Send an alert when suspicious login activity is detected.
notificationsEmailSectionDescription: Choose which events should trigger email notifications.
notificationsEmailLoginDescription: Send an email when your account is signed in.
notificationsEmailAlertDescription: Send an email when server alerts are triggered.
notificationsEmailServerHint: Mail server is configured by the system administrator. You only need to choose which notifications you want to receive.
notificationsBrowserToggleDescription: Receive real-time push notifications in the browser.
notificationsOverviewDescription: Manage how and where you receive personal notifications.
notificationsOtherChannelsDescription: System administrators can configure additional channels.
notificationsDingtalkDescription: Requires administrator to configure a DingTalk bot.
notificationsWecomDescription: Requires administrator to configure a WeCom bot.
sshSectionDescription: Manage your personal SSH key pairs.
sshEmptyDescription: Click the buttons above to generate or import keys.
sshGenerateDialogDescription: Generate a new SSH key pair for server connections.
sshGenerateAlgorithmEd25519Hint: Ed25519 is faster and more secure, suitable for modern servers.
sshImportDialogDescription: Import an existing SSH private key.
sshImportPrivateKeyHint: Import RSA, ED25519 or ECDSA keys in OpenSSH / PEM format. Convert PuTTY PPK keys to OpenSSH first.
sshViewDialogDescription: Please store your private key securely. You will not be able to view it again after closing this dialog.
sshViewPrivateKeyWarning: Save your private key now. After closing this window, you will not be able to view it again.
aiDescription: Configure your personal AI assistant settings.
aiUseSystemConfigDescription: Use the AI service configured by the administrator.
aiCustomConfigDescription: Configure your own AI API key and service.
aiModelsPlaceholder: Search models or enter a custom model
aiResetFailed: Failed to reset to system configuration.
aiResetConfirmDescription: This will delete your custom AI configuration and restore the system configuration. This action cannot be undone.
monitorDescription: Configure where server monitoring data comes from. Use EasySSH's built-in SSH collection or connect an existing third-party monitoring platform.
monitorDataSourceHint: Choose the source for server monitoring data
monitorTokenSetPlaceholder: Token is set (leave empty to keep unchanged)
monitorTokenHint: Authentication token for the external monitoring platform (optional)
monitorEasySSHHint: Use EasySSH's built-in SSH connections to collect status from added servers
monitorEasySSHNoTest: EasySSH uses built-in SSH connections, no connection test needed
aboutUpdateIdleDescription: Check GitHub Releases to see whether this Web app has a newer version.
aboutUpdateAvailableDescription: EasySSH {version} has been released. Plan an upgrade when ready.
aboutFeatureWebTerminal: Web terminal: access SSH directly from the browser
aboutFeatureFileManager: File manager: SFTP file transfer and management
aboutOpenSourceDescription: {name} is an open-source project under the MIT license.
